_note: Sample players. Paste real links into spotify, apple, and youtube. Spotify accepts an open.spotify.com track, album, or playlist URL, or the embed src. Apple Music accepts a music.apple.com link or an embed.music.apple.com src. YouTube accepts a watch URL, a youtu.be link, an embed src, or an 11-character video id. Empty strings stay as labeled sample shells so the page does not load a broken player.
